name: UiPath
tagline: UiPath is a leading robotic process automation (RPA) platform that deploys software robots to automate repetitive, rule-based tasks — form filling, data extraction, system integrations — across desktop and web applications. Its Document Understanding and AI Fabric modules add AI-powered document processing and ML models to complex automation scenarios. Large enterprises use UiPath to free employees from high-volume manual work that software APIs can't yet automate.
